integrity: The proof derives the outer-asymmetry function directly from tangent-line intersections, reduces its maximization to a rational function of one scalar variable, and proves the threshold and family maximum analytically. A standalone numerical checker independently reconstructs the geometric definition for sample parameters; the finite scan is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the original outer asymmetry constant for planar gauges whose unit disk is a translated Euclidean disk. It does not compute the normalized outer asymmetry constant, translated ellipses, arbitrary off-center centrally symmetric bodies, or higher-dimensional analogues.
title: Exact outer-asymmetry phase diagram for translated Euclidean disks
